page_title: Tuji - Screenshot, annotation, and beautification for Mac

sources.entry: Tuji - Take a screenshot, annotate it, and beautify it. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tuji/id6479216439?platform=mac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Tuji
summary.one_liner: Tuji is a macOS screenshot app that captures the screen, lets you annotate captures, and beautifies them with backgrounds, rounded corners and shadows.
use_cases: Capturing a region, window or full screen on a Mac
Annotating screenshots with callouts before sharing
Making polished screenshots with backgrounds and shadows for presentations or posts
Pinning a reference image above other windows
Quickly copying or saving edited screenshots
summary.what_it_does: Tuji captures the whole screen, a single window, or a dragged region, and also has an all-in-one capture shortcut. Captures can keep the cursor or auto-crop window shadows. Images can also be opened from disk or the clipboard. Inside the editor it supports annotation and beautification: adding a background, rounded corners and a shadow. Finished images can be copied or saved, and the editor offers pinning to top and duplicating annotations. All default shortcuts can be changed in Settings.
notable: Combined all-in-one capture shortcut and customizable global shortcuts
Beautification with background, rounded corners and shadow
Recent regions remembered for repeat captures
Listed as Freeware and on the Mac App Store
caveats: Page does not state explicit pricing details beyond the Freeware listing
